## Description

Incident response plan with breach-notification steps and timelines for DPDP and UAE regulators; Defender for Cloud and Microsoft Sentinel analytic rules routed to on-call (bulk reads/exports, failed logins, privilege changes); Customer Lockbox enabled; vulnerability disclosure policy; ADHICS control evidence pack (if UAE); ISO 27001 readiness gap assessment.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** IR plan tested in a tabletop (breach scenario) with timings recorded.
- [ ] **AC2.** Alerts for bulk export, anomalous access and privilege escalation reach on-call within 15 minutes in a test.
- [ ] **AC3.** VDP published on the trust centre; Customer Lockbox enabled.
- [ ] **AC4.** Gap assessment lists ISO 27001 controls with status and owners.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
